content.scenario: You have agreed to take part in a research study about how people learn. A researcher will ask you some questions.

questions.text: Think about a skill you learned outside of school, for example a hobby or something practical. What was the skill, and how did you learn it?
Do you prefer to learn new things alone or with other people? Why?
Some people believe that online courses will eventually replace traditional classrooms. Do you agree? Why or why not?
Should universities require all students to take at least one course outside their main subject? Why or why not?
